text:
Jordan: Posting follow-ups from today's all-hands reliability section + RCA: https://redwood.in/rca/203010. Please ack owners and volunteer if you can help.
Priya: Can we get a 1-line timeline here for quick reference?
Sam: TL;DR timeline: 03:12 alert, 03:20 partial mitigation (routing fallback), 03:48 rollback of problematic eviction, 04:05 full recovery. Root cause: cache eviction storm for a specific request shape.
Mei: Added infra notes in the RCA re: shard imbalance. Short-term: routing fallback + temp cache bump. Medium-term: rebalance + eviction fix.
Ravi: I'll own the temp cache automation + guardrails. Plan: toggle via infra-config and add an alert if hit >2x normal. ETA 3 days.
Taylor: I'll own customer comms. Drafting short note + private FAQ for enterprise. ETA: tomorrow AM.
Jordan: Leadership asks: define SLO burn thresholds that auto-trigger fallback vs cross-region failover. Who can spec?
Priya: I'll draft thresholds and playbook; will coordinate with Sam on signals. Draft by Wed.
Sam: Adding action items here (owners + due dates):
```
- A1: Temp cache automation (Ravi) - 3d
- A2: SLO thresholds & fallback spec (Priya + Sam) - 4bd
- A3: Customer comms + FAQ (Taylor) - 1bd
- A4: Shard rebalance RFC (Mei) - next sprint
- A5: Publish postmortem + status page link (Jordan) - today EOD
```
Mei: I'll open the rebalance RFC today and tag infra-ops.
Ravi: Acked A1. Quick q: metric on GPU hosts only or all nodes? I suggest all nodes.
Priya: All nodes please.
IncidentBot: incident:203010 acknowledged 03:12, mitigated 03:48, recovered 04:05. RCA: https://redwood.in/rca/203010
Jordan: Thanks all. Please post progress updates in this thread so I can close items in the all-hands tracker. If you need help, ping @oncall and #eng-oncall.
Sam: One more thing: I'll add a small Redwood Optimize eval to catch regressions from quantized cache paths. Prototype next week.
Priya: Noted, adding that as A6 (Sam) - 2w.
Taylor: I'll update support playbook after comms draft is ready.
Mei: I'll report back when staging rebalance passes smoke tests.
Jordan: Appreciate the quick ownership :raised_hands:
